summary: Excludes payouts from non-production (test) programs in three places: the twice-daily cron that withdraws spare money from Stripe (so it holds back less and withdraws more), the support-ticket priority calculation (partner lifetime payouts), and an internal reporting script.

statements.why: No new open address or leak; the money change looks intended (test-program payouts shouldn't reserve real Stripe balance). Arguably the money effect deserved a mention, counted as a miss.

statements.text: The agent changed trigger-withdrawal/route.ts, create-support-ticket.ts and scripts/processed-payouts.ts in ways plain can't describe yet.

misses.what: Money: the automatic Stripe withdrawal cron (/api/cron/trigger-withdrawal, 1AM/1PM UTC) now only reserves money for production-program payouts, so it will withdraw more from the Stripe balance to the bank; if any test-program payouts are actually paid from that balance, there may not be enough left.
Support-ticket priority for partners now counts only payouts from production programs, so some partners may get lower priority.
